name: election-producer
description: Election Producer: AP poller, Studio, on-air ticker and graphics, plus the project docs. Deployed on Vercel; npm start runs the same code on one machine.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -r public/. dist/ && cp -r ../public/g dist/g && rm -f dist/g/control.js && cp lib/control.js dist/g/control.js && cp ../config/polls.json ../config/candidates.json ../config/photos.json ../config/baseline-federal.json ../config/baseline-2024-pres.json ../config/independents-history.json ../config/quotes.json ../config/explainers.json ../config/state-notes.json ../config/party-codes.json dist/g/ && cp -r ../watch-party/public/geo dist/geo
